# Project Phoenix v49.0 — Interactive Global Situation: World Megaprojects & Wonders Race.
# Active in all eras unless `oe_v49_wonders_off` game rule is enabled.
# Strictly EU5 1.4.9 compliant: valid 01_coa.txt map_color names, zero top-level `image =`, R08/R12 safe.
# Generated by gen_v490_world_megaprojects.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_v49_wonders_race = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique

	can_start = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wdr_race_ended }
		any_country = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			num_locations >= 5
		}
	}

	visible = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			is_great_power = yes
			oe_v49_wdr_owns_any_megaproject = yes
			any_owned_location = { oe_v49_wdr_is_wonder_site = yes }
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Golden Age of Eternal Wonders (progress >= 100 OR >= 10 Tier III Eternal Wonders)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v49_wdr_end_eternal_age"
		desc = "oe_v49_wdr_end_eternal_age_desc"
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_v49_wdr_global_tier3 }
					var:oe_v49_wdr_global_tier3 >= 10
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress }
					var:oe_v49_wdr_global_progress >= 100
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_race_ended value = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						oe_v49_wdr_owns_any_megaproject = yes
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 15
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_wdr_mod_eternal_wonders_legacy years = 40 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Age of Grand Monuments (>= 16 wonders built worldwide)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v49_wdr_end_grand_monuments"
		desc = "oe_v49_wdr_end_grand_monuments_desc"
		trigger = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v49_wdr_global_wonders }
				var:oe_v49_wdr_global_wonders >= 16
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_race_ended value = 2 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						oe_v49_wdr_owns_any_megaproject = yes
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 10
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_wdr_mod_grand_monuments_legacy years = 35 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Dawn of Modern Civil Engineering (late-era horizon or disabled)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v49_wdr_end_modern_horizon"
		desc = "oe_v49_wdr_end_modern_horizon_desc"
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off
				current_year >= 1850
			}
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_race_ended value = 3 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						oe_v49_wdr_owns_any_megaproject = yes
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_wdr_mod_modern_engineering_legacy years = 30 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_wonders value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_tier3 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress value = 5 }
		oe_v49_wdr_sync_global_counts_effect = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { country_type = pop }
				NOT = { country_type = building }
				OR = {
					is_ai = no
					is_great_power = yes
				}
			}
			oe_v49_wdr_sync_country_counts_effect = yes
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		oe_v49_wdr_sync_global_counts_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v49_wdr_global_wonders >= 1
				var:oe_v49_wdr_global_progress < 95
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress add = 0.1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_wdr_global_progress > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_wdr_global_progress < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_global_progress value = 0 } }
	}

	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wdr_race_ended } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_race_ended value = 3 }
		}
	}

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_v49_wdr_location_has_tier3 = yes }
			custom_tooltip = oe_v49_wdr_map_tier3_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_v49_wdr_location_has_tier2 = yes }
			custom_tooltip = oe_v49_wdr_map_tier2_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_v49_wdr_location_has_tier1 = yes }
			custom_tooltip = oe_v49_wdr_map_tier1_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_v49_wdr_is_wonder_site = yes }
			custom_tooltip = oe_v49_wdr_map_site_tt
		}
	}

	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_v49_wdr_location_has_tier3 = yes }
			value = yellow_light
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_v49_wdr_location_has_tier2 = yes }
			value = orange
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_v49_wdr_location_has_tier1 = yes }
			value = blue_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_v49_wdr_is_wonder_site = yes }
			value = green_light
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v49_wdr_legend_tier3"
		color = rgb { 230 198 68 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v49_wdr_legend_tier2"
		color = rgb { 214 118 32 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v49_wdr_legend_tier1"
		color = rgb { 62 126 196 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v49_wdr_legend_site"
		color = rgb { 88 166 94 }
	}
}
